chapter: Depression gigs, Lil Armstrong, joining Chick Webb
title: End of the McRae Brothers Band
summary: McRae explains that the band was put together for Atlantic City, broadcast in New York, and ended in 1929 when Bill and Floyd left for Buffalo.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Did the McRae Brothers or Charlie Johnson's Band -- when you were with them or that you heard of play Baltimore or Wilmington, Washington, D.C.?

No. This particular band, that we had, like I said, we put it together -- my brother put it together (inaudible), went into Atlantic City. He made a deal with this club, (inaudible) bring the big band of that year, you know. And we went in there. And we left and we came -- after we left Atlantic City, we came back --

we came to New York.
And we did some other gigging around.
We played a couple of theaters or something like that.
Then we did this broadcast during the winter time, this whole winter. Then we went to the Savoy just before Thanksgiving.
I know it was Thanksgiving morning when we left here. (inaudible). My brother said, "I'm going to Buffalo." And my (inaudible) two brothers, Bill and Floyd, they went to Buffalo. And that was the end of the band. That was in '29.
Then I just stayed in New York. And I went back to Atlantic City -- went back, you eventually met June Clark, and went know, and here (inaudible) from one band to a little to the other small band (inaudible).
And after I left June Clark at the Club Kentucky -- we're getting up in 1933 or '34 or '35, Chick was forming his band, and Fletcher was still at the Roseland.
